verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a cap-table SaaS that advertises automated flows, such as vesting schedules, board sign-offs and registered-agent notifications, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions version history, review, or rollback for any of these automations. Its MCP integration is explicitly read-only, so it offers no route to managing automations either.
